_about: The rulebook is the single source of truth for rules and constants. Agents and tools must read values from here and cite them. status: 'official' = taken from a government or regulator document. 'vendor-guide-verify' = from company guides, MUST be verified against the official scheme guidelines before the demo. 'team-assumption' = our own illustrative number. Verified against the MNRE operational guidelines (June 2024) on 2026-10-09; see docs/RULEBOOK_VERIFICATION.md.

subsidy_per_kw_ghs.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), CFA table, S. No. 4; also the CFA structure sheet (March 2024)
subsidy_per_kw_ghs.note: For common facilities of Group Housing Societies / RWAs, including EV charging, up to 500 kWp at 3 kWp per house. Special category States/UTs get Rs 19,800 (see state overrides).

cap_kw_per_flat.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), CFA table, S. No. 4
cap_kw_per_flat.note: A CEILING, not a target. Size to the common-meter load.

cap_total_kw_ghs.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), CFA table, S. No. 4
cap_total_kw_ghs.note: The limit is inclusive of rooftop plants already installed by individual residents of the society.

grid_emission_factor.source: Central Electricity Authority, CO2 Baseline Database User Guide v21.0
grid_emission_factor.note: Weighted average for FY 2024-25 (CEA v21.0, Nov 2025). CEA has since published v22.0 (Sep 2026); update this value once its figures are checked.

yield_kwh_per_kw_year.source: Company guides quote 1,400 to 1,800. We use the low end to stay conservative.
yield_kwh_per_kw_year.note: Location dependent. Replace with a sourced city value if available.

target_share_of_load.source: Our design choice, to avoid oversizing.

cost_per_kw.source: Our illustrative figure. MNRE's benchmark cost is Rs 50,000/kW for the first 2 kW and Rs 45,000/kW after that (Rs 55,000 / 49,500 in special category States); market prices for society systems vary.
cost_per_kw.note: Benchmark: Guidelines (June 2024), section 5(g). Replace with your vendors' quotes.

price_band_per_kw.source: Derived from the guide range, widened slightly.
price_band_per_kw.note: Outside the band is a flag, not a verdict.

default_tariff_inr_per_kwh.source: Illustrative. Real value depends on state and tariff class; read it from the bill.

advance_flag_pct.source: Our policy threshold for flagging a large advance payment.

min_service_years.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), section 7(d): registered vendors provide repairs and maintenance free of cost for a 5-year Comprehensive Maintenance Contract from commissioning
min_service_years.note: A quotation offering less than 5 years of free maintenance falls short of the scheme's requirement.

sign_before_approval_warning.value: Signing with an installer or paying a large advance before DISCOM approval may put the subsidy at risk.
sign_before_approval_warning.source: Our advice. The MNRE guidelines (June 2024) do not forbid it; it is risky because the DISCOM can refuse feasibility or limit the capacity.
sign_before_approval_warning.note: Show as a caution, never as law.

registered_vendor_requirement.value: The subsidy (CFA) is available only if the system is installed by a vendor registered on the PM Surya Ghar National Portal.
registered_vendor_requirement.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), section 7(a) Registration of Vendors
registered_vendor_requirement.note: The scheme uses registration on the portal, not tender empanelment. Check the vendor's registration on pmsuryaghar.gov.in.

missed_inspection_rule.value: Guides say repeated missed DISCOM inspection appointments can lead to cancellation.
missed_inspection_rule.source: One company guide. Not found in the MNRE guidelines (June 2024); verify with your DISCOM.
missed_inspection_rule.note: Do not present as a rule.

stages.source: Vendor guides for stages 1 to 5. The subsidy stage uses the official 15 days after DISCOM approval (Guidelines section 6(t)). Real timelines often run longer (IEEFA reported 45 to 120 days overall).
stages.note: Used for chasing logic; not an official SLA.

ghs_common_facilities_only.value: The society's connection used under the scheme must serve only common facilities, not supply individual flats.
ghs_common_facilities_only.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), section 5(f)

cfa_processing_days.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), section 6(t): the CFA will be processed within 15 days of approval by the DISCOM
cfa_processing_days.note: Approval comes after the DISCOM's physical inspection and portal checklist (section 6(k)).

grievance_resolution_days.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), section 11(a): grievances raised on the National Portal are resolved within 30 days

small_system_deemed_feasible_kw.source: MNRE, Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, CFA to Residential Consumers (June 2024), section 6(h), under the Electricity (Rights of Consumers) Rules, 2020
small_system_deemed_feasible_kw.note: Systems up to 10 kW are deemed technically feasible once the state provision is operational. Most society systems are larger and need DISCOM feasibility.
